authorization: User approved the subsequent experiments on 2026-09-08; InfBaGel paper HOSI-test metrics may be directly cited; generating released-baseline motion is optional.
scope: One offline-editing phase: fixed native28 development, same-budget relation ablation at two registered bounds, separate terminal repair, then conditional fixed full469 evaluation. No expert training or HSI contribution gate.
source: Frozen P15 online + Arm B500, original 16/2 rollout and 30Hz native decode; reuse exact saved full B0 motions on native28. Subsequent full469 sources use the same per-episode seed42+canonical ordinal convention and original targets/time budget. Existing older scene-seeded full469 rows remain separate.

editing.representation: Native decoded SMPL-X pose/translation and rigid object motion, fixed shape. Horizontal common translation and yaw about original pelvis; independent arm has separate object horizontal translation/yaw. Six hip/knee/ankle local rotations can adjust support, with upper-body local pose fixed.
editing.temporal: Cubic B-spline control field, knot spacing 0.5 seconds. Freeze first6 native frames and final3 held frames; quintic 0.5-second entrance/exit envelope. No generated-history feedback after editing.
editing.risk: Sum of source full-human/full-object mean negative SDF depths. Same source-dependent step count for every arm; zero penetration returns the source.

objective.surface: sum of full-human and full-object mean relu(-SDF)/0.01m; native Scene_sdf axes/scaling/interpolation
objective.support_position: fixed-source low ankle/toe mask; mean squared XYZ displacement/(0.02m)^2, weight1
objective.support_velocity: fixed-source adjacent support pairs; squared velocity-change/(0.03m/s)^2, weight0.2
objective.residual: mean squared bounded normalized horizontal/yaw/leg changes, weight0.05
objective.temporal: mean squared adjacent control-field changes, weight0.05
objective.domain: squared new/increased distance outside native SDF cube/(0.01m)^2, weight10

editing.selection: Lowest complete registered objective among source and visited iterates; no native metric table is used inside this choice. Save every optimized term, gradient finite state, control field and timing. Equal budgets for relation/independent arms.
editing.geometry: All SMPL-X vertices and full object mesh in objective; original native15 definitions unchanged, including official object subsampling, 5cm contact, 10cm completion, source task length and floor estimator. Native output geometry drives final evaluation.
editing.memory: GPU frame chunks24 with one-frame overlap for temporal derivatives; no approximate vertex subset or CPU physical optimization.

terminal.scope: Separate arm after deterministic development selection; successful tasks are exact identity. If no editing arm meets entry protections use B0 as terminal source and retain failed scene edits.
terminal.target: For each failing pelvis XZ/object XYZ endpoint, move toward its supplied goal, aiming8cm distance and capping each translation norm at5cm. Quintic ramp over final1 second, fixed first6 and held last3; original motion duration unchanged.
terminal.repair: 20 Adam steps, lr0.05, same surface/support terms, six upper-arm/elbow/wrist local rotations plus six leg rotations; joint bounds20deg. Active source native hands within5cm retain their object-frame anchors, squared error/(0.01m)^2, weight1. Transform endpoints are prescribed; no extra future or new object goal.
terminal.accept: Retain corrected whole task iff completion changes false to true, contact loss<=2pp, FS increase<=0.02cm, and each native HS/OS increase<=0.05. Otherwise retain input. Report candidates and all reasons; these are task-level method choices, not erased experiments.

evaluation.primary: OS s_mean on full tasks; HS s_mean, contact, completion, FS, endpoints and all other native15 fields retained. Realism audits and fixed videos are descriptive.
evaluation.development_choice: Eligible relation arm: OS at least10% below B0, HS mean<=B0, contact mean>=B0-0.02, completion count>=B0, FS mean<=B0+0.02cm, world hand-object maximum relation drift<=1e-4m, initial/final motion unchanged. Select lower OS, tie favors10cm. No confidence-bound or per-window all-improve gate.
evaluation.full469_entry: Automatic within user approval if a relation arm meets development_choice. Freeze bound/steps/objective/terminal rule. Evaluate source, selected independent ablation, selected relation and relation+terminal on all469; old28 remains development-used and remaining441 has historical use.
evaluation.uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap replicates seed42; task and scene units; no frame independence or cross-training-seed inference. Fixed-method uncertainty does not correct adaptive test-set development.

paper_reference.comparison: Direct paper reference authorized. External aggregate, unpaired, historical representation; no locally rerun significance claim.

verification: Full authority pytest tests and registry validation. Source native reconstruction/metric equality and differentiable surface/rigid-relation/end-lock checks. Real-data evaluation and synchronized compute timings inside registered workload; no additional smoke workload, new hashing mechanism or defensive wrappers. Frozen core/expert paths unchanged.
completion: One preregistration, one logical implementation and one completion commit for this phase; preserve operational/scientific failures and immutable outputs. Deliver compact result, all task/scene tables, fixed videos, phase summary and next entry.
